name: Church Attendance
overview: Scripture emphasizes the joy and priority of gathering in the house of the Lord, as David expressed gladness at the invitation to worship together (Psalms 122:1). Jesus affirms the foundation of His church and the spiritual presence when believers assemble in His name (Matthew 16:18; 18:20). The early church modeled steadfast commitment to fellowship, teaching, prayer, and breaking of bread both in the temple and in homes, demonstrating the importance of regular, united attendance and shared worship (Acts 2:42, 46). Seeking God's kingdom first includes valuing and participating in the community of believers as a vital expression of faith (Matthew 6:33).
